image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a lionfish (Pterois) swimming in an underwater reef environment. The fish displays characteristic red and white vertical stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins extending horizontally, and elongated dorsal spines rising vertically. The background consists of blurred coral and rock formations.
